slot_reservation_semantics: The active o_work_monitor_recovery role is the reserved O main/recovery execution slot. Do not require an additional empty physical automation slot unless O authoritative state proves the main execution path is physically separate.

o_work_monitor_recovery.policy: Inspect latest O authoritative repository state first. Treat WORK_EXECUTION_STATE owner/fence plus heartbeat_at/last_progress_at and same-owner remote branch/PR/CI progress as primary liveness evidence; automation UI last_run_time is secondary and must never override a fresh authoritative owner. Fresh owner/activity means no duplicate writer and no recovery mutation. Only after stale lease/heartbeat and absence of same-owner fresh progress is actual stop established; then recover using the existing lease/fence/CAS/readback contracts. Revision 23 least-Work is already acknowledged, so route repository/GitHub-capable work outside Work and never interrupt an existing frozen Work-exclusive invocation. Individual blockers, no-change, reports, checkpoints, CI completion, or one milestone are never global completion. Transient tool/network/API failures are checkpointed and retried. Never self-disable; only explicit user stop. Persist exact observations/actions/blocker/termination/continuation and rollback-relevant evidence durably.

o_human_request_monitor.policy: Read the durable O user-request queue from current main and compare only against the last successful repository baseline. Notify only newly open, materially changed, or reopened requests; unchanged open, fulfilled, withdrawn, superseded, missing queue, or no-change cases do not notify. A reevaluate_by date passing is not itself a synthetic new request or notification trigger unless the authoritative queue object changes. Read-only: never mutate O or queue. Transient read failure does not advance the comparison baseline and is retried next run. Persist exact successful baseline and receipt durably.
